 Mom discovers $12,000 hidden in her daughter’s closet. Then her daughter wearing brand new Prada shoes says she “had to do what she had to do”
 She had Prada on her feet and a mystery in her closet
 By 
 Umme Tun Nessa 
 Oct 20th, 2026, 5:56 am 
 Save us as a preferred source in Google 
 Share 
 Share 
 Share 
 Finding thousands of dollars in your teenager’s closet would raise questions for any parent. But one mother became furious after discovering a large amount of cash hidden in her 16-year-old daughter’s shoebox. Her expensive Prada shoes only made things more suspicious.
 Parents and children often clash over money , sometimes leaving the internet divided over who’s right. But having thousands of dollars without a job is another matter. And this teenager’s explanation only made the situation worse.
 In a video shared by TikTok account AshleyTvShow (@ashleytvshow), a mother confronts her daughter after reportedly finding $12,000 in her shoebox. The clip, which has received over 247,000 views, shows the teenager refusing to explain where the money came from while her mother threatens to call the police.
 So, what’s really going on here?  
 The confrontation begins with the mother demanding answers about the cash. “What is this? Are you serious?” she asks before noticing her daughter’s expensive footwear. “Look at you. You got brand new Prada’s on you,” she adds, reminding the teenager that she’s only 16. But instead of explaining herself, the girl repeatedly questions why her mother was searching through her closet.
 Things become more suspicious when the mother mentions her daughter’s two phones. She wants to know how someone her age, apparently without a job, could afford all these things. However, the teenager dismisses her concerns, insisting that the phones don’t matter. Her mother continues pressing her about the money, refusing to accept her evasive responses.
 Eventually, the daughter offers an explanation, though it doesn’t reveal much. “Mama, I had to do what I had to do,” she responds, suggesting that school isn’t working for her anymore. Her mother immediately becomes upset, warning that she could end up in jail. She even threatens to call the police, apparently suspecting that the money came from something illegal.
 The argument takes another turn when the teenager admits she hasn’t been attending school. “I haven’t been going to school for the longest,” she reveals. The admission only makes her mother angrier, as she insists her daughter should have finished her education. Financial disputes between parents and teenagers have sometimes ended in legal trouble , but this mother seems ready to involve the police without knowing how her daughter obtained the cash.
 Throughout the confrontation, the teenager continues demanding her belongings back and questioning why her mother searched through them. She insists she has to do what she has to do, but never reveals what that actually means.
 Viewers had questions of their own  
 Despite the mother’s concerns, many viewers thought she was overreacting. Some argued that having money doesn’t automatically mean someone is doing something illegal. “Making money is not a crime,” one commenter pointed out. Another questioned the police threat, asking, “how is that grounds for the cops to come”.
 Others suggested the teenager might have earned the money herself. “Maybe she is reselling,” one person speculated, while another added, “She probably saved it for years.” Some were more concerned about the invasion of privacy, with one asking, “why is she going all through her closet anyway.”
 Several commenters even accused the mother of wanting the money. “She just want the money she dont even care about her,” one viewer claimed. Another joked, “I trust my mum she’s keeping half before the confrontation.”
 However, not everyone disagreed with the mother. One viewer defended her reaction, writing, “mom is right my parents would have called the cops dad would say not in our house.” Another argued, “if you’re doing wrong you have to get out of my house.”
 Still, the teenager’s source of income remains a mystery. And while her mother fears the worst, viewers are questioning whether threatening to call the police was the right response.
